name: Cradlepoint / Ericsson
evidence_summary: Ericsson/Cradlepoint sources evidence cellular-centric SD-WAN, 5G, link bonding/SASE and network slicing positioning.
cost_model: Quote-based NetCloud subscriptions + routers/adapters; public hardware pricing may exist through resellers.
key_differentiators: Wireless-first branch architecture from Ericsson with deep 5G expertise; NetCloud provides cellular-centric SD-WAN management.
Strong story for organisations adopting 5G as a primary access medium rather than as a backup.
Network slicing and private 5G integration roadmap is more credible than competitors lacking cellular heritage.
best_fit_for: Distributed enterprises with strong cellular/5G access strategy (retail, logistics, transport, public sector).
Buyers consolidating wireless WAN with traditional fixed-line SD-WAN under one operational tool.
Organisations interested in private 5G integration with branch SD-WAN.
watch_outs: SASE story is partner-integrated rather than native; SSE capabilities require validation in RFP.
Cloud on-ramp and multi-cloud transit fabric have limited public evidence relative to dedicated SASE platforms.
Best for cellular-led architectures; less strong as a primary fit for fixed-circuit-heavy estates.
verification_notes: Re-verified 2026-07-29 against named primary sources. Every graded fact carries a source, a tier and a verbatim quote confirmed present on the cited page by an independent check. Industry, region, organisation-size and pricing evidence was sourced on the same basis. Facts that could not be sourced are published as unknown with the reason. The value_tier field is a Netify assessment of relative cost position, not a supplier claim: most of this market publishes no price. Sources found and rejected are listed at tier 4.

ai_capability.note: NetCloud AIOps with anomaly detection and the NetCloud AI assistant.

resilience.note: Wireless WAN failover is the core use case; dual-SIM and dual-modem designs.

profile.platform_architecture: Cradlepoint, part of Ericsson, leads cellular-first WAN: E-series and R-series routers and adapters built around 4G and 5G with NetCloud SaaS management. Wireless WAN is the design centre, from branch failover to primary 5G connectivity for sites, vehicles and IoT. Ericsson ownership ties roadmaps to 5G network capability, including private network integration.
profile.security_sase: NetCloud has grown a zero-trust layer: NetCloud Exchange provides ZTNA and secure connect services over cellular, with firewalling on-box and web security integrations. The Ericom acquisition added isolation-based security capability. Treat the security stack as solid for cellular-led estates rather than a full SASE replacement for deep CASB/DLP needs.
profile.service_support_channel: Strong carrier and channel routes (cellular operators bundle Cradlepoint widely) with healthy UK distribution; public safety, transport and retail are signature verticals. NetCloud subscriptions include support, with 24x7 tiers and managed offers through partners and operators.
profile.commercials_verdict: Subscription-first: hardware bundled into NetCloud plans per device. The Netify verdict: shortlist Cradlepoint when wireless is strategic, not just backup: day-one site openings, vehicles and field operations, 5G-primary branches and IoT estates. For wired-first enterprises it is the resilience and agility layer alongside a conventional SD-WAN or SASE platform.

vendor_faqs.q: Is 5G reliable enough as primary WAN?
vendor_faqs.a: Increasingly yes, where coverage allows: Cradlepoint estates run thousands of 5G-primary sites with dual-SIM and dual-modem designs handling carrier diversity. Model traffic and validate coverage per postcode before committing.
Cradlepoint's extension of NetCloud into zero-trust services: ZTNA and secure connectivity built for cellular-connected sites, vehicles and IoT, managed from the same console as the routers.

vendor_faqs.q: How does Ericsson ownership matter to buyers?
vendor_faqs.a: Roadmap alignment with 5G evolution, including private networks and operator integrations, plus financial backing. For organisations betting on cellular WAN, that backing derisks the platform.

shortlist_summary: Cradlepoint, now part of Ericsson, offer a wireless-first branch architecture with deep 5G expertise, with NetCloud providing cellular-centric SD-WAN management and the Ericsson acquisition adding carrier-grade credentials. Typically shortlisted by businesses where fixed-line connectivity is unavailable, unreliable or not preferred, and where cellular primary or failover is a hard requirement rather than an edge case.
cost_note: Subscription-led cellular WAN; cost-effective where 5G primary or backup replaces fixed lines.
uk_basis: No UK HQ (US, Ericsson-owned). UK delivery via mobile operators and partners.

f01_fully_managed_service.quote: Enterprise Wireless products are sold through our world-class global ecosystem of distributors, resellers, managed service providers, and integrators.
f01_fully_managed_service.note: Nothing on the pages reviewed describes Ericsson Cradlepoint itself designing, deploying, monitoring, changing and reporting on a customer network end to end. The route to market is indirect and the partner programme casts managed delivery as a service provider partner activity, so a fully managed wrap is a partner outcome rather than a vendor service.

f03_co_managed_service.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The NetCloud Service page, the support page and the NetCloud SASE page describe a customer operated SaaS console with vendor supplied 24x7 technical support, but no page reviewed sets out a co-managed engagement in which Ericsson runs the service while the customer retains defined policy and change rights. Absence of a quote is not treated as absence of the capability.

f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.quote: Enterprise Wireless products are sold through our world-class global ecosystem of distributors, resellers, managed service providers, and integrators.
f04_multi_tenant_msp_white_label_support.note: Managed service providers are an explicit channel and the partner programme names a service provider category that builds managed offerings on the platform, which implies multi customer operation. However no page reviewed documents tenant isolation, delegated administration, branded portals or templates under the partner's own brand, so this is graded partial rather than yes. NetCloud Manager subaccount structure is referenced in the security page bullets but not in language firm enough to quote for white labelling.

f05_professional_services_and_migration_.quote: These specialized partners have deep knowledge of our products and offer an array of high-value services.
f05_professional_services_and_migration_.note: Design, integration and implementation services are attributed to the reseller and integrator channel rather than to an Ericsson Cradlepoint professional services organisation. The vendor supplies training and certification directly, but no discovery, pilot, staging, migration runbook or rollback offering was found on the pages reviewed, so the capability is graded as delivered through partners.

f07_lifecycle_management.quote: Your wireless edge routers and adapters, or endpoints, include a product warranty for the duration of your active NetCloud Essential or Advanced subscription.
f07_lifecycle_management.note: Hardware warranty runs for the life of the subscription and the same page states that NetCloud Manager continuously delivers real time cloud and device operating software updates to 5G and LTE endpoints, so firmware and software currency are part of the subscription. End of life planning and renewal management are implied by the subscription continuity wording but are not separately documented.

f17_cellular_and_5g_support.quote: With benefits like traffic steering based on cellular attributes and network slicing for guaranteed bandwidth as networks evolve to 5G standalone, NetCloud SASE enables fast moving organizations to accelerate their transformation.
f17_cellular_and_5g_support.note: This is the supplier's core competence. The data sheet additionally describes SD-WAN optimising traffic across wired, 5G and LTE, satellite, Wi-Fi as WAN, private APNs and 5G standalone network slices, and the endpoint range is built around integrated cellular modems. Traffic steering on cellular attributes evidences signal level awareness.

f19_public_cloud_gateways.quote: Zero-trust security and SD-WAN services can be consumed through the cloud using NetCloud SASE or deployed in a private data center or private cloud through NetCloud Exchange.
f19_public_cloud_gateways.note: Ericsson operates its own cloud delivered SASE service, with the NetCloud SASE page describing Ericsson's global cloud delivering zero trust security and SD-WAN as a service through NetCloud Manager. This is the vendor's own service infrastructure, not a resold third party edge, so yes rather than partner_integrated. Confidence is medium because the security page states the cloud services are hosted within Amazon Web Services and no gateway or region list is published.

f20_private_pops_dedicated_pops.quote: Flexible deployment in a customer-hosted data center or cloud or downloaded on a physical server.
f20_private_pops_dedicated_pops.note: The NetCloud Exchange Service Gateway is offered as a customer hosted headend in the customer's own data centre or private cloud, which meets the customer hosted or dedicated test. The NetCloud SASE page also states that certain NetCloud SASE services can be implemented through a customer hosted model in addition to cloud delivered options. Sovereign deployment is not separately claimed.

f21_private_global_backbone.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The NetCloud SASE product page, the SASE data sheet, the Service Gateway data sheet and the security page were all checked for backbone, private network core or inter region transit language and none was present. The security page instead states the cloud back end is hosted within Amazon Web Services, which is third party infrastructure rather than a vendor owned backbone. No claim either way is asserted.

f26_sla_backed_service_fabric.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The support page describes 24x7 global telephone support and the NetCloud Service page describes enterprise level support, but neither states contractual uptime, response or change handling commitments. The legal document index at cradlepoint.ericsson.com/legal returned only a loading state, so any published service level agreement could not be read.

f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.quote: With application and web filtering plus integrated IDS/IPS, HMF brings in modern firewall features, without the complexity.
f27_integrated_next_generation_firewall.note: The hybrid mesh firewall in NetCloud Exchange combines application control, web filtering and integrated IDS/IPS in the platform. The NetCloud SASE data sheet separately describes scanning incoming web traffic for known virus signatures so the secure web gateway can block malicious content, and application visibility and enforcement using deep packet inspection. No third party firewall vendor is named on any page reviewed, so this is graded as native rather than partner_integrated.

f33_data_loss_prevention.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The NetCloud SASE product page carries a benefit bullet about retaining data and intellectual property in the era of GenAI, and the data sheet describes a cloud access security broker, but neither describes content classification, inspection of sensitive data, blocking or flagging before egress, or exception workflows. The zero trust security page contains no DLP language at all. Graded unknown rather than no.

f40_managed_service_assurance.quote: Support is one of the most valuable tools within a NetCloud subscription and is staffed by accredited network engineers
f40_managed_service_assurance.note: Round the clock global support is documented, with centres in Boise, London and Melbourne and direct access to the engineering organisation, and a public NetCloud status page exists for incident notification. What is not documented on any page reviewed is a 24/7 NOC and SOC proactively monitoring the customer's service, incident ownership through to root cause analysis, structured service reviews or change governance, so this falls short of the full definition.

delivery_model.quote: Enterprise Wireless products are sold through our world-class global ecosystem of distributors, resellers, managed service providers, and integrators.
delivery_model.note: Ericsson Cradlepoint authors the NetCloud platform, endpoints and NetCloud SASE software. Sales and delivery run through distributors, resellers, MSPs and integrators rather than Ericsson operating the service for the end customer, so this reads as a technology vendor rather than a managed provider.

underlay_ownership.note: Ericsson Cradlepoint sells endpoints, cloud management and SASE software, and the product proposition is bonding and steering whatever WAN links the customer already has, including wired, cellular, satellite and Wi-Fi as WAN. No page reviewed shows the supplier selling or owning access circuits or a core routing network for enterprise WAN customers, and the route to market is through distributors and resellers rather than a carrier contract.

sse_layer_ownership.quote: NetCloud SASE is based on a clean architecture that delivers one platform, one policy engine
sse_layer_ownership.note: The security service edge functions, secure web gateway, remote browser isolation, ZTNA, CASB, IDS/IPS and hybrid mesh firewall, are all presented as Ericsson NetCloud components on a single policy engine. No third party security vendor is named as the underlying technology on any page reviewed, so this is graded native. Confidence is medium rather than high because the pages do not explicitly state that every component was built in house.

regulatory_documentation.quote: From incident response to acceptable use, Ericsson's documented IT policies, baselines, and procedures meet or exceed industry standards.
regulatory_documentation.note: This is a general assurance sentence, not a named framework. Both the trust centre landing page and the security page were checked and neither names ISO 27001, SOC 2, NIS2, DORA, NHS DSPT, GDPR compliance status or FedRAMP. The security page does document penetration testing of hardware and NCOS, encryption at rest and in transit, and a responsible disclosure process, but attestation evidence was not present.

pop_count.note: Not found in public sources reviewed. The NetCloud SASE product page, the SASE data sheet, the Service Gateway data sheet and the security page carry no count of points of presence, edge locations or regions. The Service Gateway ordering table lists only All Regions with no regional breakdown.

sla_availability_pct.note: No availability percentage was found. The support page and NetCloud Service page describe 24x7 support without any uptime figure, the trust centre links to a NetCloud status page rather than a published availability target, and the legal document index would not render so any service level agreement document could not be opened. A mention of support without a percentage is graded unknown.

sectors.healthcare.quote: Aspen Medical specialises in providing healthcare services, including modular and temporary clinical infrastructure, in environments that are remote, challenging and under-resourced
sectors.healthcare.note: Single named healthcare customer (Aspen Medical, Australia, COVID clinics and vaccination programme), from a supplier press release dated 22 June 2021. There is no healthcare landing page, no healthcare filter in the resource library and no hospital or health system in the current success story set, so the evidence is one dated deployment rather than a sustained sector practice. Confidence held at medium for that reason.

sectors.financial_services.quote: For pop-up locations such as seasonal stores, tax prep offices, and election polling places, wired connectivity often either isn't available or is too expensive.
sectors.financial_services.note: Checked the UK industries page, the branch and branch continuity product pages, the retail collateral, the resource library, the full page sitemap and all 198 press release titles in the press release sitemap. No bank, credit union, insurer, payments firm or financial services customer is named anywhere, and there is no financial services landing page. The nearest mention is tax prep offices in a list of pop-up location types, which is not sector evidence. Graded unknown.

sectors.retail_ecommerce.quote: In Valvoline Instant Oil Change locations, franchisee Henley Enterprises uses Ericsson's multi-WAN, cellular-enabled solution to curb downtime.
sectors.retail_ecommerce.note: Strongest sector on the site. Multiple named customers (Henley Enterprises for Valvoline, DiPasqua Enterprises operating over 100 Subway locations, T-Mobile retail across more than 5,000 storefronts, Wawa referenced), plus a retail section on the UK industries page and dedicated retail collateral. Evidence is store connectivity and failover rather than ecommerce platforms.

sectors.manufacturing.quote: Private networks built for the rigours of manufacturing
sectors.manufacturing.note: Manufacturing is one of four industries given a headed section with descriptive copy on the UK industries page, but no manufacturing customer, plant deployment or case study was found on any page read. The nearest named private cellular customers are Port of Tyne (a port) and, on the construction page, Taylor Construction and Bilfinger Global IT. Graded partial because the sector is named with detail but nothing is shown behind it.

sectors.energy_utilities.quote: Our Smart Oil Field Maturity Assessment helps IT and OT leaders evaluate their progress in digitalizing operations and adopting advanced digital solutions.
sectors.energy_utilities.note: Graded yes on the basis of a dedicated oil and gas sector page offering a named assessment service (Ericsson Smart Oil Field Assessment). No named oil and gas customer appears on the page, and no electricity, water or utility customer was found anywhere on the site, so the grade rests on the dedicated page alone and confidence is medium. Oil and gas only, not utilities.

sectors.government_public_sector.quote: Ericsson Enterprise Wireless Solutions has a seven-year NASPO ValuePoint Data Communications Products and Services contract
sectors.government_public_sector.note: Multiple independent strands: a published NASPO ValuePoint contract with per-state participating addenda pages, a named UK public body (Avon Fire and Rescue Service, 21 stations, June 2023), and a City of Cheyenne success story in the current resource library. Public safety also has its own headed section on the UK industries page.

sectors.education.quote: University of Illinois Delivers Interactive Experiences at Live Events Across US Leveraging Cradlepoint Wireless 'Pop-up' Branch Networks
sectors.education.note: Named education customer, but the press release is from July 2018 and the deployment was pop-up connectivity at live theatre venues rather than campus or classroom networking. Corroborated by the NASPO contract vehicle, whose Washington addendum explicitly lists state universities, regional universities, community colleges and technical colleges as eligible purchasers, and whose national description names colleges and school districts. There is no education landing page. Confidence medium given the age of the customer evidence.

sectors.transport_logistics.quote: Lufthansa Cargo is one of the world's leading cargo airlines, serving about 350 destinations worldwide in about 100 countries
sectors.transport_logistics.note: Three separate strands: Lufthansa Cargo private 5G at its LAX warehouse, Port of Tyne named on the private 5G product page, and a Seattle transit agency success story in the current resource library. Transdev Sydney Ferries also appears as a press release title in the press release sitemap, though that page was not opened.

sectors.professional_services.quote: Australian employment services company's Wireless WAN networking infrastructure lowers cost, helps remain agile during COVID-19 and sets pathway to 5G
sectors.professional_services.note: One named customer, WISE Employment, an Australian nonprofit employment services provider with over 160 offices, from a press release dated 15 December 2020. Graded partial rather than yes because whether employment services counts as professional services is a taxonomy judgement, and no consulting, legal, accountancy or staffing firm is named anywhere else on the site. There is no professional services landing page.

sectors.hospitality_leisure.quote: It enabled the government to mandate facial recognition technology in all gaming facilities, including pubs, clubs and casinos with more than 30 machines in a venue.
sectors.hospitality_leisure.note: Reached indirectly. The contracting party is Vix Vizion, a facial recognition technology partner; the pubs, clubs and casinos are the end venues in South Australia, and the deployment was driven by state gambling law reform rather than by a hospitality buyer. No hotel, restaurant chain, stadium or leisure operator is named directly. Note a possible conflict of classification: the Subway franchisee story (evidence 2) is a quick service restaurant operator, which some taxonomies place under hospitality rather than retail. Recorded, not resolved.

regions.uk_ireland.quote: London, United Kingdom — June 8, 2023 — Cradlepoint, the global leader in cloud-delivered LTE and 5G wireless solutions, announced that Avon Fire and Rescue Services (Avon FRS) will be using Cradlepoint routers, powered by NetCloud to provide failover support to ensure unfailing and continuous connectivity across the Service's 21 stations.
regions.uk_ireland.note: Delivered service evidenced by two named UK customers (Avon Fire and Rescue Service, 21 stations; Port of Tyne private 5G), a dedicated UK site section at /gb/, a UK sales line on the contact page, and BT listed among certified European carrier partners. The press release sitemap also shows ESN accreditation releases for the R1900 router on Great Britain's Emergency Services Network. No Ireland-specific customer, office or partner was found; the grade rests on UK evidence.

regions.europe.quote: assesses 11 selected players who are actively delivering private 5G solutions for enterprise customers in the European market
regions.europe.note: Vodafone, BT and Deutsche Telekom are listed as certified European carrier partners on the supplier's network operators page, and the contact page carries a German sales number (+49 40 82211740) alongside a line described as covering the United Kingdom and parts of Europe. The IDC MarketScape quote is a third-party statement of active European private 5G delivery, but it is hosted on the vendor's own site and the report body was not opened, so it is corroboration rather than the primary basis. Locale sitemaps exist for Austria, Belgium, Denmark, Finland, Germany, Netherlands, Norway, Portugal, Spain, Sweden, France and Switzerland, but website language is not treated as delivery evidence.

regions.north_america.quote: Ericsson Enterprise Wireless Solutions has a seven-year NASPO ValuePoint Data Communications Products and Services contract
regions.north_america.note: Deepest coverage of any region. A live multi-state US public sector contract vehicle with per-state participating addenda, US and Canadian carrier certifications (AT&T, Verizon, T-Mobile, UScellular, Rogers, Bell), the sole physical office address (Boise, Idaho) and an Americas sales line. Named US customers include City of Cheyenne, Valvoline via Henley Enterprises, DiPasqua Enterprises and Lufthansa Cargo at LAX.

regions.asia_pacific.quote: The distribution partnership will enable Cradlepoint to accelerate operations initially in Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, and Thailand, with plans to expand into other markets in the region longer term.
regions.asia_pacific.note: Australia is the strongest sub-market: Telstra, TPG Telecom and Optus are listed as certified carrier partners, an Australian sales line is published (+61 1300 295 134), and three named Australian customers appear (Aspen Medical, WISE Employment, and gaming venues via Vix Vizion). Southeast Asia is served through a named distributor covering Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia and Thailand as at July 2021. The press release sitemap also shows an India software development subsidiary and New Zealand and Malaysia locale sitemaps. No Japan or Korea evidence was found.

regions.middle_east_africa.quote: Cradlepoint on the Lookout for New Channel Partners to Leverage Multi-Billion Wireless WAN Market in EMEA
regions.middle_east_africa.note: Deliberately held at partial with low confidence. The only evidence is a channel recruitment press release dated 27 August 2020 that refers to EMEA collectively and names no Middle Eastern or African country, partner, carrier or customer. No Middle East or Africa operator appears on the network operators page, there is no regional sales number on the contact page, and the South Africa locale pages listed in the en_za sitemap now redirect to the global homepage. Treat EMEA in this supplier's material as effectively Europe unless a buyer confirms otherwise.

regions.china_mainland.quote: We work closely with network operators across the globe to plan, optimize, and certify our products for their LTE and 5G networks.
regions.china_mainland.note: The quoted global claim is treated as evidence of nothing for mainland China, per the brief. No Chinese carrier (China Mobile, China Telecom, China Unicom) appears in the certified operator list, there is no zh locale in the sitemap index, no China office or sales number is published, and no ICP or licensed local arrangement is mentioned anywhere. Mainland China would need a specific licensed arrangement that this supplier does not publish.

organisation_fit.large_global_enterprise.quote: Lufthansa Cargo is one of the world's leading cargo airlines, serving about 350 destinations worldwide in about 100 countries
organisation_fit.large_global_enterprise.note: Named multinational customers across several pages: Lufthansa Cargo, Bilfinger Global IT (named on the construction industry page via a regional IT business partner), and T-Mobile with more than 5,000 storefronts on network failover. Backed by an enterprise-oriented product and licensing model and a public sector contract vehicle.

organisation_fit.mid_market.quote: By deploying wireless edge routers to provide Internet and connectivity to over 160 offices across Australia, with more than 1,000 employees, WISE's wireless plans came to fruition.
organisation_fit.mid_market.note: Clear mid-market evidence: WISE Employment at roughly 160 sites and 1,000 staff, DiPasqua Enterprises running over 100 Subway locations with a two-person IT team, Henley Enterprises as a Valvoline franchisee, and City of Cheyenne. The distributed multi-site organisation with a very small IT team is the recurring customer profile in the supplier's own stories.

organisation_fit.small_business.quote: Ericsson's Small Office/Home Office (SOHO) solutions deliver enterprise-class connectivity plus security to help mission-critical employees remain productive and protected outside the office.
organisation_fit.small_business.note: Held at partial. A SOHO product line and a Small Sites subscription package exist, and the press release sitemap shows a small site router launch, but the published framing is consistently small sites and home-based employees within larger organisations, not small businesses as buyers. No SMB pricing, no self-serve purchase route (products are sold only through distributors, resellers, MSPs and integrators) and no small business named as a customer. Carrier-fronted business internet offers with T-Mobile and UScellular may reach small businesses, but those press release pages returned 404 and were not read.

published_pricing.note: No price is published that we could quote. The value_tier field on this record is a Netify assessment of relative cost position, not a supplier claim.

conflicts.claim_a: NetCloud Exchange Service Gateway is a scalable and reliable services delivery platform (or headend) that can reside standalone or in an active/standby configuration in a customer's data center or hosted cloud.
conflicts.claim_b: NetCloud Exchange Service Gateway is for on-premises deployments only and is a reliable headend solution that can reside standalone or in an active/standby configuration.
